title: SEC filing: Quantinuum is seeking to raise $1.05B in its US IPO, marketing ~21M shares for $45 to $50 each, giving it a $12.7B valuation at the top of the range (Carmen Reinicke/Bloomberg)
summary: Carmen Reinicke / Bloomberg: SEC filing: Quantinuum is seeking to raise $1.05B in its US IPO, marketing ~21M shares for $45 to $50 each, giving it a $12.7B valuation at the top of the range — Quantinuum Inc., a quantum computing company backed by Honeywell International Inc., is seeking to raise $1.05 billion …
